title: Right coordinate route equals canonical Kunneth map after composition
statement: theorem coordinateKunneth_rightRoute_comp_kunneth [Finite A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) : (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app M).app ((push A f).obj ((pull A f).obj L)) ≫ (push A f).map (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).map (exchange1 A f ((pull A f).obj L)).hom ≫ (orderedProjectionIso A (pullback.fst f f) M ((pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj ((pull A f).obj L))).hom)) ≫ (rightDerivedLowerStarCompIsoOfComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst f f) f (pullback.fst f f ≫ f) rfl).hom.app _ = kunnethMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.snd f f) f f (pullback.fst f f ≫ f) rfl (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := f)).symm M ((pull A f).obj L)

proof.text: Specialize the existing proved general-base factorization kunnethMap_eq_of_isPullback to p = pullback.fst f f, q = pullback.snd f f, both structure maps f, c = p followed by f, E = M and K = Lf* L. This factorization is kunnethMap_eq followed by tensorBaseChangeMap_eq_projectionMap: the ordinary projection, tensor of the canonical square exchange, projection for p conjugated by the two canonical braidings, and the adjunction-normalized direct-image compositor. Unfold only the coordinate wrappers exchange1, orderedProjectionIso and swap. The exchange square is the flipped self-pullback square by proof irrelevance. The canonical derived tensor symmetry is precisely the same signed braiding as in the general factorization. Symmetry identifies the final swapped braiding with the inverse braiding. Associativity gives the displayed route unchanged, so the symmetric equality of the existing factorization is the conclusion.
